0022600123.text: The Pacers (2-1, 2nd in the Central, 5th in the East) come into this fourth game of their season on a win streak of one, after going 2-0 on the road, while the Bucks (0-3, 5th in the Central, 13th in the East) are on a three-game losing streak. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring) and Andrew Nembhard (neck soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Pacers lost all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently 134-123 in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
